Introduction

Jeon Soyeon is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, producer, and dancer under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the leader and main rapper of the girl group i-dle (formerly (G)I-DLE).

She first gained attention as a contestant on Produce 101 in 2016, placing 20th, and later as the second runner-up on Unpretty Rapstar 3. After signing with Cube Entertainment, she debuted as a soloist in 2017 with the single "Jelly" and later made her group debut in 2018, as the leader of i-dle, with the mini album "I Am".

Soyeon has participated in notable collaborations, including the girl group project for "SM Station X 0" (the third season of SM Entertainment's digital music project) and as a voice for the virtual K-pop group K/DA, portraying the character Akali for League of Legends. She also joined the virtual hip-hop group True Damage in 2019 and collaborated with IVE's Liz and æspa's Winter on the 2023 single "Nobody".

In 2025 Soyeon was revealed as the creative director and producer of the girl group Baby DONT Cry.
